summary: @ornikar/react-modern-calendar-datepicker 3.2.9 ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes hidden bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is written with javascript-obfuscator style `_0x`-hex identifiers and inline dispatch lookup objects, and at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temp path, chmods it executable, and runs `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` against a 727KB sibling file. math_init.js is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array rotation obfuscation (shuffle routine, large mixed constants array, charset-decoder) with no readable source, unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a React calendar/datepicker). The design executes an obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on `npm install`, which bypasses Node-based static inspection of the executed code. The package name mimics the well-known react-modern-calendar-datepicker library under the @ornikar scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
